filename: George Frideric Handel - Adagio and Allegro.md
title: Adagio and Allegro
identity: Handel, Adagio and Allegro, in the inspected Eugene Rousseau/Wingert-Jones alto saxophone and piano edition. A separate baritone saxophone edition also exists; the catalog entry may refer to another edition.

evidence.claim: Rousseau edition 3050061 is listed for alto saxophone and piano; product description identifies contrasting Adagio and Allegro movements and baroque ornamentation.
A separate Rousseau baritone saxophone preview confirms another saxophone arrangement exists, not the alto edition.
Opened product page identifies the edition as alto saxophone and piano, arranged by Eugene Rousseau, Wingert-Jones catalog 3050061; page includes a preview image link.

Visually inspected publisher-linked score sample image. It is titled Adagio and Allegro for E-flat alto saxophone and piano, arranged by Eugene Rousseau; the displayed page shows a lyrical Adagio followed by a faster Allegro section with more continuous running figures.
evidence.source_name: Wingert-Jones 3050061 score sample hosted by Stanton’s

score_observations.claim: The sample page begins with a slow, slurred Adagio line with sustained notes and dynamic shaping. Later on the same sample page, the Allegro section has denser running-note passages, slurs, accents, and stronger dynamic markings. The image contains the saxophone line rather than the full piano score.
score_observations.scope: Publisher-linked preview for the alto saxophone part, not all cataloged editions.

review_focus: Inference from inspected Rousseau/Wingert-Jones sample: review the change from sustained slurred Adagio phrasing to the Allegro’s denser running figures, with attention to articulation, dynamic contrast, and Baroque ornamentation. No level is proposed.
collection_flag: A saxophone arrangement of Handel; arrangement status is established, while intended audience and the precise catalog edition remain unresolved.

score_links.description: Opened and visually inspected Wingert-Jones 3050061 E-flat alto saxophone sample page.
Retail product listing links to this sample; other saxophone editions remain distinct.

gaps: A matching saxophone performance recording was not verified or auditioned.
Multiple versions/arrangements exist or are plausible; the catalog target edition needs confirmation.
The inspected image is only the alto saxophone part and does not resolve which of the separate Southern editions in the catalog is intended.
